mapper.select: SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.username, pm.full_name, pm.project_role, pm.status, pm.joined_at, pm.created_at, pm.updated_at, pm.created_by, pm.updated_by, pm.active, u.role AS system_role, u.email, u.phone, u.tg_username, u.position AS user_position, u.department_id, d.name AS department_name FROM project_members pm LEFT JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.username, pm.full_name, pm.project_role, pm.status, pm.joined_at, pm.created_at, pm.updated_at, pm.created_by, pm.updated_by, pm.active FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.id = #{id}

SELECT pm.id, pm.project_id, pm.user_id, pm.username, pm.full_name, pm.project_role, pm.status, pm.joined_at, pm.created_at, pm.updated_at, pm.created_by, pm.updated_by, pm.active FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, username, full_name, project_role, position, status, joined_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, active) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{fullName}, #{projectRole}, #{position}, #{status}, #{joinedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, #{active})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM project_members WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT project_id FROM project_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}
